title: Write Scope Required Error (422)
description: 422 body when a project-scoped write arrives without an explicit project: send the `X-Project-Id` header or use a project-bound API key. It is the catch-all handler's closed shape (see global_error_schema.json), with `code` "PROJECT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED" and `error` one of four fixed sentences. No client-supplied value is echoed.

enum: Explicit project scope is required for this write: send the X-Project-Id header or use a project-bound API key.
write scope does not match the request context
write scope project not found for tenant
bootstrap write scope is not available inside a request
error.description: Fixed sentence naming why the write scope was refused.
